newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Banc One EPS view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Banc One EPS view cut.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities said Tuesday it reduced its 1997 earnings estimate for Banc One Corp to $3.50 a share from $3.70, while increasing its 1998 estimate to $4.25 a share from $4.15.

-- On January 20, Banc One said it agreed to buy First USA Inc. EVEREN said it adjusted the earnings estimates to take this acquisition into account. It added the company projected earnings per share dilution of seven percent in 1997 and break-even effect in 1998, and accretive thereafter.
-- It also increased its price targets to $55 a share from $53 for the intermediate term and to $63 from $60 for the long-term.
-- Banc One shares were up 1-31/64 at 43-1/8.
